svg.title: Names in namespaces, objects on the heap
svg.desc: Three regions. Tag 1, the module's namespace, holds the names speed_mps and drive. Tag 2, the namespace of the call drive(10.0), holds the names distance_m and time_s. Tag 3, the heap, holds the objects: a float 0.5, the function drive, a float 10.0 and a float 20.0. Each name has an arrow to its object.
